p0_findings.finding: verify_repo_identity requires the source ep35 checkpoint lexical path to be a symlink, while the ep40 factor verifier rejects that same un-resolved source path if it is a symlink. The canonical run deterministically fails before valid825.
p0_findings.minimal_fix: Handle source separately as an exact symlink plus exact resolved target and SHA, or pass its already-verified resolved regular path into the factor verifier; keep ep40 checkpoint/state non-symlink.

p0_findings.finding: Training installs factorized ATLIF after model.to(cuda), so balanced SVD runs on GPU. The verifier rebuilds ep35 factors on CPU and uses torch.equal. Backend floating-point and SVD sign/subspace choices can make an untrained GPU initialization differ from the CPU reconstruction, falsely proving all 45 pairs changed.
p0_findings.minimal_fix: Emit and seal the actual 45-pair initialization from the training process before its first optimizer step, then compare ep40 to that snapshot. Otherwise remove the proven-changed claim.

p0_findings.finding: The M513 consumer resolves the input directory before checking is_symlink, so the canonical leaf path can be a symlink and the intended rejection is ineffective.
p0_findings.minimal_fix: Check exact lexical canonical path and reject its leaf symlink before resolve; only then inspect exact members and seals.

p0_findings.finding: Staging population ignores extra directories, prepublish checks do not reverify every member digest, and a postpublish verification failure or kill leaves canonical RUN_COMPLETE and seals in place rather than quarantining them.
p0_findings.minimal_fix: Use the full consumer verifier on staging before rename, including every directory entry and JSON semantics. On any ordinary postpublish failure atomically quarantine canonical first and assert the postcondition.

p1_findings.finding: Waiting occurs only if the exact watcher tag is already present and has no timeout or periodic state receipt.
The second nvidia-smi query narrows but does not eliminate noncooperating launch races. Raw GPU CSV is recorded but exact one-A800 UUID/model/driver/index0 is not required.
Three major import roots and three environment variables are handled, but repo-root import shadows and the DSEC sample-content manifest remain outside the identity gate.
Attempt/result use mkdir -p with no EXIT trap, FAILED_DO_NOT_CITE marker or partial-result quarantine, so failures block safe rerun and leave ambiguous artifacts.
Final semantics do not cross-check factor receipt config/checkpoint/state/source hashes against current artifacts, and only require M513 upstream_identity to be a dictionary at final publication.
The persisted END sample is taken before final repo/input checks and package staging/sealing/publication; no fourth actual SHA is sampled after successful publication.

required_before_r3: compare ep40 factors with actual pre-step training-process initialization
reject M513 lexical directory symlink before resolve
fully preverify and quarantine failed canonical publication
decision.source_drift_note: The runner path changed after the exact target had been read. This review deliberately does not authorize or assess the later SHA.
